from typing import List

def norm_sg03(rows: List[str]) -> List[str]:
    pass

# 测试数据
test_cases = [
    ["  Hello", "hello", "HELLO", "  World", "world"],
    ["  a", "  b", "  c", "  d", "  e", "  f"],
    ["  aa", "  bb", "  cc", "  dd", "  ee", "  ff"],
    ["  aaa", "  bbb", "  ccc", "  ddd", "  eee", "  fff"]
]

# 断言
assert all(len(row) <= 6 for row in norm_sg03(test_cases[0]))
assert all(row.startswith("> ") for row in norm_sg03(test_cases[0]))
assert all(len(set(row.lower() for row in test_cases[0])) == len(norm_sg03(test_cases[0])))
assert all(len(row) == 6 for row in norm_sg03(test_cases[1]))
assert all(norm_sg03(test_cases[2])[0].startswith("> a") and norm_sg03(test_cases[2])[1].startswith("> b") for _ in range(10))
```

from typing import List

def norm_sg04(rows: List[str]) -> List[str]:
    pass

# 测试数据
inputs = [
    ["Hello World", "  hello", "Good  morning", "  Good Afternoon"],
    ["  Python  ", "  python", "  PythoN", "  pYthoN"]
]

# 断言
assert all(row[0] == '#' for row in [norm_sg04(rows) for rows in inputs])
assert all(row.islower() for rows in [norm_sg04(rows) for rows in inputs] for row in rows)

assert all(rows == sorted(rows, reverse=True) for rows in [norm_sg04(rows) for rows in inputs])
